english.title: Non-licence holder - held out as having / engaged in conduct calculated to suggest that person held licence to practise
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being a person who did not hold a licence to practice granted under and in accordance with Part IIIA of the Medical Act 1983,

(A)_[held yourself out as having]_
(B)_[engaged in conduct calculated to suggest that you had]_

such a licence
english.legislation: Contrary to section 49A(1) of the Medical Act 1983.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
being a person not holding a licence to practice
held themselves out as having such licence AND/OR
engaged in conduct calculated to suggest that they have such licence

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.standardstatementoffacts:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), the defendant, being a person who did not hold a licence to practice granted under and in accordance with Part IIIA of the Medical Act 1983,

(A)_[held himself out as having]_
(B)_[held herself out as having]_
(C)_[engaged in conduct calculated to suggest that he had]_
(D)_[engaged in conduct calculated to suggest that she had]_

such a licence.
